    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">QGIS开发笔记（五）：qgis加载标记点功能，基础标记数量与性能对比测试</span>
    

</a>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  对地图增加标记点、标记图标、线条、图形等等，都是常规通用操作，本篇先实现添加标记点，然后对比点数量性能，同时由于像素大小对性能也有较大印象，测试了1、2像素超大数量绘图时，拽托性能与显示效果。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="QsgVectorLayer_27"></a>QsgVectorLayer</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_28"></a>概述</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  QgsVectorLayer是QGIS中用于处理矢量数据的核心类，它负责加载、管理和操作各种矢量空间数据（点、线、面等几何类型）。<br>  其作为矢量数据的容器，连接数据源（如 Shapefile、PostGIS、GeoJSON 等）并提供数据访问接口。加载矢量数据、管理属性表、处理几何对象、实现空间查询等。继承自QgsMapLayer，与QgsRasterLayer共同构成QGIS中两种主要的图层类型。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_31"></a>数据源连接字符串</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  创建QgsVectorLayer时需要指定数据源字符串（data source string），格式因数据格式而异：<br>  </p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="Provider_34"></a>常用驱动（Provider）</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  </p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_36"></a>注意事项</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_37"></a>内存管理</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  QgsVectorLayer对象通常由QgsProject管理，调用 QgsProject::addMapLayer后无需手动删除。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_39"></a>非线程安全</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  QGIS 核心类（包括QgsVectorLayer）不保证线程安全，避免在非主线程中直接操作。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_41"></a>性能优化</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>对大数据集使用空间索引（layer-&gt;createSpatialIndex()）。</li>
<li>批量操作时使用QgsVectorLayerUtils::addFeatures()替代循环添加。</li>
<li>避免频繁调用 commitChanges()，建议批量修改后一次性提交。<br>  通过QgsVectorLayer，可以在C++中实现QGI 几乎所有矢量数据处理功能，结合QgsGeometry、QgsFeature 等类可完成复杂的空间分析任务。</li>


</ul>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_46"></a>常用属性和操作</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_47"></a>构造与初始化</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  通过数据源字符串（URI）、图层名、数据提供者类型构造 QgsVectorLayer。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 加载 Shapefile
QString uri <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string">"/path/to/data.shp"<span class="token punctuation">;
QgsVectorLayer<span class="token operator">* layer <span class="token operator">= <span class="token keyword">new <span class="token function">QgsVectorLayer<span class="token punctuation">(uri<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token string">"my_layer"<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token string">"ogr"<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token operator">!layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">isValid<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token comment">// 处理加载失败
<span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token comment">// 添加到地图画布
<span class="token class-name">QgsProject<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">instance<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">addMapLayer<span class="token punctuation">(layer<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_59"></a>图层基本信息</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<ul>
<li>geometryType()：返回图层几何类型（QgsWkbTypes::GeometryType）。</li>
<li>crs()：返回图层坐标系（QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem）。</li>
<li>fields()：返回属性字段集合（QgsFields）。</li>
<li>featureCount()：返回要素总数。</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 图层名称
QString name <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">name<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 几何类型（点/线/面等）
QgsWkbTypes<span class="token operator">::Type geomType <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">wkbType<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 坐标参考系（CRS）
QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem crs <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">crs<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 要素总数
<span class="token keyword">int featureCount <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">featureCount<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 空间范围
QgsRectangle extent <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">extent<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_82"></a>属性表操作</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  属性表由QgsFields管理，每个字段对应QgsField：</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 获取所有字段
<span class="token keyword">const QgsFields<span class="token operator">&amp; fields <span class="token operator">= layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">fields<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 遍历字段
<span class="token keyword">for <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token keyword">int i <span class="token operator">= <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">; i <span class="token operator">&lt; fields<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">count<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token operator">++i<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token keyword">const QgsField<span class="token operator">&amp; field <span class="token operator">= fields<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">at<span class="token punctuation">(i<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token function">qDebug<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"字段名:" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; field<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">name<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) 
             <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"类型:" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; field<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">typeName<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}

<span class="token comment">// 根据名称查找字段索引
<span class="token keyword">int fieldIndex <span class="token operator">= fields<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">indexOf<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"population"<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<h3><a id="_98"></a>要素迭代与访问</h3>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  通过QgsFeatureIterator遍历要素：</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token comment">// 获取要素迭代器（默认遍历所有要素）

    <span class="token comment">// 要素 ID

    <span class="token comment">// 几何对象（转为 WKT 字符串）
    QgsGeometry geom <span class="token operator">= feature<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">geometry<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    QString wkt <span class="token operator">= geom<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">asWkt<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token comment">// 属性值（通过索引或字段名访问）

    QVariant id <span class="token operator">= feature<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">attribute<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token comment">// 字段索引

    <span class="token function">qDebug<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"FID:" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; fid <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"几何:" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; wkt 
             <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">"人口:" <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; population<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">toInt<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

</div>

<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token operator">!layer<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">deleteFeature<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">2<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">{ <span class="token comment">// 删除 ID=2 的要素

<span class="token punctuation">}

<span class="token comment">// 提交编辑（保存修改）
